title: White House Rules Out Diesel Export Ban as Prices Surge Above $6.50
summary: The White House on Wednesday denied that the Administration is considering a ban on U.S. diesel exports, clarifying comments from President Donald Trump and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent a day earlier that appeared to leave the door open to restrictions as the average diesel price in America topped $6.50 per gallon. A White House official denied a report that the Administration was preparing a 90-day ban on diesel exports, while Energy Secretary Chris Wright said nobody was considering a flat ban on shipments. title: Gaza flotilla activist on hunger strike in Tunisia jail ‘on verge of death’
